title: Tic Tac Toe game

business_case_summary:
Business Case Summary: Tic Tac Toe game (DEM-2026-0006)

Executive Summary
This project develops a simple console-based Tic Tac Toe game to showcase basic game logic and programming fundamentals in the Games domain.

Direct Business Value/Impact
Provides a quick, low-effort demonstrator for developer skills and team training, boosting morale and portfolio value with minimal resource use.

Potential Risk Mitigation
Low risk level addressed by straightforward scope, no external dependencies, and console-only execution for easy testing and deployment.
